config.title: configuration
config.generalTabIntro: Manage all dashboard settings from this page — appearance, layout, bookmarks, search, smart collections, and more. Click Save to apply changes; the dashboard updates without a full page reload.
config.colorsTabIntro:
Fine-tune dashboard and config colors here. Edit the default dark and light palettes, or create your own under Custom themes — then click Save colors to apply. Dozens of built-in themes are already available in General → Appearance if you want a ready-made look without editing every color.
Auto dark mode (General → Appearance) only works with built-in dark/light theme pairs — it is disabled when a custom theme is selected.

  • Click Rebind next to any shortcut, press your preferred key, then Save in the config header.
  • Enable Use shortcuts from all pages in General → Bookmarks — Behavior so keys work outside the dashboard.
  • Reset one shortcut or all bindings to defaults from the same screen.

config.statsInfoActivityMsg: Shows how many bookmarks had their last-open timestamp fall within each time bucket. This is a recency proxy — it reflects when bookmarks were last used, not a full click history.

config.statsInfoShortcutsMsg: Coverage bar showing how many bookmarks have a shortcut assigned. The table lists the top 20 shortcuts ranked by open count.
config.statsInfoRotMsg: 'Never opened' lists bookmarks with zero opens ever. 'Stale' lists bookmarks not opened within the selected period. Use the Health page to archive or remove them.
config.statsInfoConflictsMsg: Duplicate URLs are bookmarks sharing the same address. Shortcut conflicts occur when a shortcut is assigned to more than one bookmark. Use the Health page to resolve them.
config.statsInfoSearchMsg: A snapshot of your current search and monitoring settings: whether the search index is built, which modes are active, and how many bookmarks have status checks enabled.

config.showSearchFlowBannerInfoMessage:
Shows the small banner above the buttons that explains the main search flow.

• > opens search
• : opens commands

Enabled:
• Press any letter to start fuzzy search (find bookmarks by name)
• Press '/' followed by letters to use shortcuts (e.g., /yt for YouTube)

Disabled:

config.packedColumnsInfoMessage:
When enabled, bookmark/category blocks are distributed round-robin across columns on wider screens.

• Reduces empty vertical gaps
• Can make reading order feel less top-to-bottom
• Saved instantly when toggled
config.showSyncToastsInfoMessage:
Show or hide cross-tab sync toasts.

• On: brief confirmation when another tab applies config/settings updates
• Off: no sync popup noise, but sync still happens
config.globalShortcutsInfoMessage:
When enabled, shortcuts from every page can be used anywhere.

• Faster launch across pages
• Higher chance of shortcut conflicts if duplicates exist
config.showBookmarkStatusInfoMessage:
Enables status indicators for bookmarks.

• Status checks only run for bookmarks with their status toggle enabled
• Useful for service links, but can add extra network checks
config.skipFastPingInfoMessage:
Changes how status checks run.

• Off: quick connectivity ping first, then HTTP check
• On: skip quick ping and run HTTP-only check
• Use if fast ping causes false negatives in your setup

config.helpPageQuickStartItems:
• Open search with >, type a bookmark, press Enter.
  • Press + to open the quick-add omnibox — type name | url | shortcut in one line.
  • Press & (dashboard) or Ctrl+Shift+A (anywhere) to open the full new-bookmark modal.
  • Open recent bookmarks with *.
  • Open keyboard cheatsheet with ! or Ctrl+/.
  • Open config#general — use ℹ next to settings for help.
config.helpPageWhatsNewIntro: A short recap of recent dashboard and config changes.
config.helpPageWhatsNewItems:
• ℹ info buttons in config — click ℹ next to any General setting for a short explanation in your language (EN / NL / DE / FR).
  • Essentials / Advanced — config → General is split into everyday options and power features; jump links in Advanced or show all sections at once.
  • Tuning wizard — after onboarding, an optional one-time guide on the dashboard: language → theme → browser extension.
  • Dynamic PWA manifest — custom title and favicon apply to /manifest.webmanifest and installed home-screen apps.
  • Dashboard grid accessibility — bookmark tiles use grid ARIA roles; keyboard focus rings and aria-selected on arrow-key selection.
  • Unified toasts — dashboard and config share the same notification toasts (including undo).
  • Help & README — Config → Help → General settings and the README explain Essentials vs Advanced and the ℹ buttons for self-hosters.
config.helpPageOnboardingItems:
• On first launch, a short guided setup helps configure the dashboard in minutes.
  • You can choose language, link behavior, weather/date preferences, search mode, and how to use bookmarks from the keyboard and mouse.
  • The wizard supports live language switching while you are in onboarding.
  • After onboarding, a optional tuning wizard (language, theme, extension) may appear once on the dashboard — see Config → General in this help.
  • You can always skip wizards and change everything later in config#general.
config.helpPageNavigationItems:
• Switch pages with number keys 1-9.
  • Move between pages with Shift + Left/Right.
  • Navigate bookmarks with Up/Down and Left/Right.
  • Press Tab / Shift+Tab to step linearly through all bookmarks when one is already selected.
  • Press G then a digit 1–9 to jump to the nth visible category and select its first bookmark. GG jumps to the very first bookmark.
  • Open selected bookmark with Enter or Space.
  • Clear keyboard selection with Esc (also undoes the latest drag reorder when applicable).
config.helpPageBookmarksDashboardItems:
• Keyboard: arrow keys move the highlight; Tab / Shift+Tab steps linearly through bookmarks when one is selected; G + digit jumps to the nth category; ; (semicolon) opens inline edit on the highlighted row.
  • Quick-add (+): press + anywhere on the dashboard (when no input is focused) to open the quick-add omnibox at the bottom — type name | url | shortcut in one field and press Enter. Favicon is fetched automatically.
  • New-bookmark modal (& / Ctrl+Shift+A): press & on the dashboard or Ctrl+Shift+A anywhere (when no input is focused) to open the full add-bookmark form with page, category, preview, and more options.
  • Paste to quick-add (Ctrl+V): paste a URL to open the new-bookmark modal pre-filled with that URL. Works when no input is focused and search is not active.
  • Mouse — left strip: the narrow drag handle on the left of each row is for dragging: reorder inside a category or drop into another category column.
  • Mouse — long-press: press and hold about half a second on the bookmark row (not on the drag strip) to open the same inline edit form.
  • Hover: when Link Preview Cards are enabled, hovering a bookmark shows a rich preview card (title/description/image/domain). You can disable cards or tune hover delay (100/150/250 ms) in config#general → Dashboard.
config.helpPageSearchItems:
• > open normal search, : commands, ? finders.
  • + open the quick-add omnibox — type name | url | shortcut and press Enter to add a bookmark without leaving the dashboard.
  • & (dashboard) or Ctrl+Shift+A (anywhere) open the full new-bookmark modal.
  • / fuzzy search behavior depends on the configured search mode.
  • Use commands like :layout, :density, and :buttons for quick UI changes.
  • :history — browse recent searches from the command bar; :history clear wipes all history. Or open search with an empty query and hover a history row to × delete individual entries.
  • Filter autocomplete: start with category:, status:, page:, or tag: and pick a suggestion.
  • tag: filters by tag — e.g. tag:work shows only bookmarks tagged work.
  • status: values: online, offline, checked, unchecked, pinned, unpinned, broken, ok.
  • page: values: current, all, or a page number like page:2.
  • Turn on "Keep search open when empty" for fast repeated searches.
config.helpPageDateWeatherItems:
• Toggle date and time independently, and choose date format: short slash, short dash, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, weekday only, or long weekday.
  • Choose time format: 24-hour or 12-hour AM/PM.
  • Date/time render on one line as 13:35 @ 30-04-2026; weather renders on the next line.
  • Weather line includes a small icon per condition (clear/cloudy/rain/snow/fog/drizzle/thunderstorm/unknown).
  • Enable weather display and select location source (browser or manual city).
  • Set Celsius/Fahrenheit and weather refresh interval from the Date & Weather card in general settings.
  • If weather does not show, verify manual location text and save once.
config.helpPageSmartItems:
• Today, Recently opened, Stale bookmarks, and Most used are built-in smart collections.
  • Each can be enabled/disabled independently and limited to specific pages.
  • Set item limit to 0 for unlimited.
  • Enable Tag collections in config → general → Smart Collections to auto-generate one collection per tag.
  • Set a minimum bookmark count to filter out rarely-used tags.
  • Smart sections support collapse/expand on the dashboard.
config.helpPageTagsItems:
• Add comma-separated tags to any bookmark in config → bookmarks or via the inline editor on the dashboard.
  • Tags are normalized: trimmed, lowercased, and deduplicated on save.
  • Filter bookmarks by tag with tag:work in the search bar — partial matches supported.
  • View all tags in config → tags: see usage counts, rename, merge, and delete tags.
  • The tag cloud at the top of the tags tab gives a visual overview — larger = more used.
  • Enable Tag collections in config → general to automatically show one dashboard group per tag.
config.helpPageCollectionsItems:
• Create dynamic bookmark groups in config → collections.
  • Each collection has a name, optional icon (emoji), match logic (AND/OR), and one or more rules.
  • Rule fields: tag, category, or shortcut. Operators: includes or excludes.
  • AND: all rules must match. OR: at least one rule must match.
  • Collections appear as groups on the dashboard alongside smart collections.
  • Changes save immediately — no need to press the main Save button.
  • Tag collections (auto-generated per tag) and custom collections are shown before regular categories on the dashboard.
config.helpPageSortingItems:
• Pinned bookmarks always stay on top of non-pinned bookmarks.
  • Pinned state is shown with a compact pin icon on dashboard rows.
  • Pinned bookmarks are always sorted alphabetically.
  • Non-pinned bookmarks use your selected sort mode (manual, A-Z, recent, pinned-first behavior).
  • Categories can be collapsed and can default to collapsed.
  • Drag the grip handle (⠿) that appears when hovering a category title to reorder categories directly on the dashboard — the new order is saved automatically.
  • Category order can also be changed in config → categories by dragging the rows.
config.helpPageManageItems:
• Use the config workspace to manage pages, categories, and bookmarks in one place.
  • Create pages with templates, archive/restore pages, and run quick actions via Ctrl+K/Cmd+K.
  • The Bookmarks tab uses a split-view layout: compact list left, detail panel right. Edit all fields: name, URL, page, category, shortcut, icon, tags, note, pinned, and status check.
  • Add comma-separated tags in the detail panel or inline editor — saved normalized (trimmed, lowercase).
  • Bookmarks support favicon fetch from URL (auto on URL blur or manual via Fetch favicon).
  • Set icons via upload or icon URL in the detail panel.
  • Bulk actions: select rows, move category or page, toggle pin, delete, and bulk refresh favicons.
  • Use Alt+Up / Alt+Down to reorder quickly within the list.
config.helpPageFindersItems:
• Format: ?shortcut your query (example: ?g nextdash).
  • Use %s in finder URL where query should be inserted.
  • If bookmark and finder share a shortcut, both options are shown in search context.
config.helpPageStatusItems:
• Enable status checks to display online/offline state.
  • Optionally show ping and loading indicators.
  • Use "Skip fast ping check" to reduce noise and speed up checks.
  • Open /health for issue triage: ping broken links, run auto-heal (archive, redirect detect, refresh title, 1-click fix), and delete bookmarks directly from Health.
  • Preview cards and metadata refresh settings are documented in config help sections.
config.helpPageHealthItems:
• Visit the health page (accessible from the dashboard header) to monitor all your bookmarks in one place.
  • Each bookmark gets a 0-100 health score based on multiple factors: broken status, duplicates, staleness (unused time), missing metadata.
  • View 8 summary statistics: total bookmarks, healthy, broken, duplicates, unchecked, stale, missing preview, and unused.
  • Use filter pills to focus on specific issue types (broken, duplicate, stale, etc.).
  • Search bookmarks by name, URL, category, or page to find items quickly.
  • Click the refresh button to re-scan all bookmarks and detect the latest issues.
  • Bulk actions: retest all checked bookmarks, open all broken links at once, or merge duplicate groups.
  • Ping results are cached to avoid repeatedly checking the same URLs.
config.helpPageTipsItems:
• Tips rotate every 5 to 8 seconds.
  • After every 5 normal tips, a priority tip is shown.
  • Priority tips include recent, cheatsheet, ; inline edit, left-strip drag hint, navigation, and & for the full add-bookmark form.
  • Normal tips also mention keyboard rebinding — see Help → Keyboard shortcuts.
  • The & modal lets you set name, URL, page, category, shortcut, icon (URL or upload), and a note when creating a bookmark.
  • You can toggle tips in config#general under Dashboard.
config.helpPageBackupItems:
• Backup & restore is in config → general → Backup & restore.
  • ZIP backup exports pages, bookmarks (including tags), categories, settings (including collections), and themes. Importing replaces all current data — always create a backup first.
  • Browser import: export bookmarks from Chrome, Firefox, or Edge as an HTML file. Folders become categories; duplicate URLs are skipped.
  • CSV export: download all bookmarks as CSV (Name, URL, Category, Page, Shortcut). Opens in Excel or Google Sheets.
config.helpPageBrandingItems:
• Under Essentials: theme, font size, animations, layout preset, density, and dashboard title.
  • Under Advanced → Appearance: background, fonts, and favicon harmonization.
  • Enable auto dark mode to follow system appearance.
  • Upload custom favicon and custom font in Advanced → Branding.
  • Customize colors under Config → theme for custom themes.
config.helpPageDataItems:
• Server-side data is stored in /data.
  • Device-specific settings are stored in browser local storage.
  • When device-specific mode is enabled, visual behavior can differ between devices.
config.helpPageTroubleshootItems:
• No bookmarks visible: check page selector and category filter in config.
  • Sorting seems wrong: verify sort mode and pin state.
  • Tips not visible: enable "Show tips above buttons" in Dashboard settings.
  • Search misses items: try fuzzy search and filter syntax (e.g. tag:work).
  • Collections not showing: check config → collections and verify at least one rule has a value.
  • Tag collections empty: ensure bookmarks have tags and the minimum count is not too high.
  • Paste-to-add not working: make sure no input field has focus, search is closed, and "Paste URL to quick-add bookmark" is enabled in config → general → Bookmarks.
  • Quick-add omnibox (+) not responding: make sure no input field has focus and no modal is open.
  • New-bookmark modal (& / Ctrl+Shift+A) not responding: make sure no input field has focus and no other modal is open. On US keyboards, press Shift+7 for &, or use Ctrl+Shift+A from anywhere.
config.helpPageTroubleshootFooter: Found a bug or have feedback? Visit the GitHub repository to report issues or suggest improvements.
config.bookmarkDashboardPreviewHint: Hover to see the full tile
config.bookmarkLinkPreviewEmpty: No preview metadata yet — refresh to fetch title, description and image.
config.categoriesIntro: Categories organise bookmarks within a page. Select a page to manage its categories.
config.findersIntro: Finders are quick-search shortcuts that open a filtered view on the dashboard when triggered by a key combination.
config.pagesIntro: Pages group your bookmarks. Each page has its own set of categories and bookmarks on the dashboard.
config.featureTourHint: Start the interactive tour: learn search, finders, commands and key settings.
config.themeInfoMessage:
Chooses the colour theme for the dashboard and config.

• Includes built-in dark/light and any custom themes from Config → theme
• Saved when you click Save in config
config.autoDarkModeInfoMessage:
Automatically switches between light and dark theme based on your system preference.

• Only works with built-in themes that have dark and light variants
• Not available with custom themes — those use one fixed palette
• Useful on laptops and phones that follow OS appearance
config.autoDarkModeUnavailableHint: Not available with custom themes. Custom themes use one fixed palette instead of separate dark and light variants. Select a built-in theme to enable auto dark mode.
config.systemAppearanceHintActive: Auto dark mode is on — the dashboard theme follows this system appearance.
config.systemAppearanceHintIdle: Your OS appearance right now. Enable auto dark mode to switch themes when this changes.
config.systemAppearanceHintUnsupported: System appearance shown for reference. Auto dark mode needs a built-in dark/light theme pair — not available with custom themes.
config.backgroundPickerInfoMessage:
Optional wallpaper behind the bookmark grid.

• None: plain theme background
• Auto: gradient matched to the active theme
• Gradient / Image: pick a preset or paste an image URL
• Opacity slider controls how strong it appears
config.backgroundOpacityInfoMessage:
How visible the background is (65–100%).

• Lower values keep bookmarks easier to read
• Applies to gradient and image backgrounds
config.showBackgroundDotsInfoMessage:
Subtle dot pattern on the dashboard background.

• Purely decorative
• Turn off for a cleaner look
config.enableAnimationsInfoMessage:
UI transitions and motion effects.

• On: smoother category collapse, modals, etc.
• Off: snappier feel, can help on slower devices
config.fontPresetInfoMessage:
Font family for the whole interface.

• Mono fonts suit the terminal aesthetic
• Sans fonts are easier for long reading
config.fontSizeInfoMessage:
Global text scale from xs to xl.

• Affects bookmarks, config, and search
• Combine with density for tighter layouts
config.fontWeightInfoMessage:
How bold body text appears.

• Normal is default
• Semi-bold / bold increase contrast on dense screens
config.iconStylingInfoMessage:
Tints bookmark favicons to match the active theme.

• Muted / Tinted / Overlay styles
• Intensity slider controls strength
• Preview shows sample icons
config.columnsInfoMessage:
How many bookmark tiles fit on one row (1–6).

• Wider screens often suit 3–4
• Launcher layout may ignore this
config.layoutPresetInfoMessage:
Overall bookmark grid style.

• Default, Compact, Cards, Masonry, List, Launcher, etc.
• Each changes spacing, card shape, and row height
config.densityModeInfoMessage:
Spacing between tiles and text size within the preset.

• Comfortable → Dense → Auto
• Auto adapts to screen size and zoom
config.showDashboardTitleInfoMessage:
Shows the nextDash title (or custom title) at the top.

• Off: more vertical space for bookmarks
config.launcherIconSizeInfoMessage:
Icon scale when using the Launcher layout preset.

• Only applies in Launcher mode
config.calendarUrlInfoMessage:
Link opened when you use the calendar shortcut from the date line.

• Example: Google Calendar, Outlook web
• Leave empty to disable
config.showIconsInfoMessage:
Shows favicon or custom icon on each bookmark.

• Fetched automatically when adding links
• Can be refreshed from config → bookmarks
config.showShortcutsInfoMessage:
Displays keyboard shortcut labels on tiles.

• Used with / or letter search depending on search mode
• Global shortcuts setting affects cross-page use
config.showPinIconInfoMessage:
Small pin marker on pinned bookmarks.

• Pin via command :pin or inline edit
config.showNoteIconInfoMessage:
Indicator when a bookmark has a note.

• Notes are edited with :note or inline edit
config.showLinkPreviewCardsInfoMessage:
Hover card with title/description preview for a bookmark.

• Only on keyboard focus or hover
• Delay setting avoids accidental popups
config.linkPreviewHoverDelayInfoMessage:
How long to wait before showing the preview card.

• Fast (100ms), Balanced (150ms), Calm (250ms)
config.bookmarkSortingInfoMessage:
Default order for bookmarks on each page.

• Manual: drag order
• A–Z, Recently used, Pinned first
config.openLinksInNewTabInfoMessage:
Opens bookmark URLs in a new browser tab.

• Off: replaces the current tab
• HyprMode (Advanced) changes PWA behavior
config.pasteUrlQuickAddInfoMessage:
Paste a URL on the dashboard to open the new-bookmark flow.

• Works when no input field is focused
• Ctrl+V on dashboard
config.languageInfoMessage:
Interface language for dashboard, config, and modals.

• Applies immediately in config
• Extension popup follows its own locale rules
config.showDateInfoMessage:
Date line in the dashboard header.

• Format chosen below when enabled
config.dateFormatInfoMessage:
How the date is formatted.

• Examples shown in the dropdown
• Locale-aware weekday names use your language setting
config.showTimeInfoMessage:
Clock in the dashboard header.

• 12h or 24h format below
config.showWeatherWithDateInfoMessage:
Shows temperature (and conditions when available) beside the date.

• Requires location settings below
config.weatherSourceInfoMessage:
How location is determined.

• Manual: city name you enter
• Browser: asks permission for geolocation
config.weatherLocationInfoMessage:
City or place name for manual weather lookup.

• Example: Amsterdam, Berlin
config.weatherUnitInfoMessage: Celsius or Fahrenheit for displayed temperature.
config.weatherRefreshInfoMessage:
How often to fetch new weather data.

• 10, 30, or 60 minutes
config.enableSmartCollectionsInfoMessage:
Automatic categories such as Today, Recently opened, or Stale.

• Master toggle enables/disables all smart collections
• Configure each type under Advanced → Smart collections
config.buttonBarPositionInfoMessage:
Where the footer button bar sits.

• Center-bottom (default), bottom-left, or bottom-right
• Launcher view (⊞) is always toggled via the fixed button at the bottom-right
config.showDockLayoutSelectorInfoMessage:
Shows a layout switcher in the footer dock.

• Quick switch between layout presets without opening config
config.colorizeStatusInfoMessage:
Changes tile colour when a bookmark is online/offline.

• Requires bookmark status to be enabled
config.showPingTimesInfoMessage:
Displays response time in milliseconds next to status.

• Only when status checks are enabled
config.showStatusLoadingInfoMessage:
Spinner or loading state while a status check runs.

• Helps on slow networks
config.deviceSpecificSettingsInfoMessage:
Stores certain preferences per browser/device instead of globally.

• Useful when phone and desktop need different layouts
config.enableCustomFaviconInfoMessage:
Upload an icon shown in the browser tab for nextDash.

• Does not change bookmark icons
config.enableCustomTitleInfoMessage:
Replaces the default nextDash title in the tab bar.

• Optional: include current page name
config.showPageInTitleInfoMessage:
Appends the active page name to the browser tab title.

• Only when custom title is enabled
config.fuzzySuggestionsStartWithInfoMessage:
When fuzzy suggestions are on, only show matches that start with your query.

• Off: also matches text in the middle of names
config.generalEssentialsHint: Tip: use ℹ next to a setting for help. Switch to Advanced for power features, or show all sections below.
config.generalAdvancedHint: Use the section links above to jump. Essentials covers everyday options.
config.layoutPresetDescIntro: Choose how bookmarks are displayed: Default, Compact, Cards, Terminal-ish, Masonry, List, Widgets, or Launcher.
config.densityDescIntro: Density controls spacing and typography: Comfortable, Compact, Dense, or Auto.
config.layoutPresetDesc.default: Balanced spacing and single-line bookmark rows.
config.layoutPresetDesc.compact: Reduced gaps and padding for tighter columns.
config.layoutPresetDesc.cards: Card containers with room for two-line bookmark titles.
config.layoutPresetDesc.terminal: Monospace, single-line rows with terminal style cues.
config.layoutPresetDesc.masonry: Variable card heights in a masonry grid.
config.layoutPresetDesc.list: Detailed rows with more text per bookmark.
config.layoutPresetDesc.widgets: Block-style modules with larger touch targets.
config.layoutPresetDesc.launcher: Large icons optimized for app-launcher style.
config.densityDesc.comfortable: Larger row height and calmer spacing.
config.densityDesc.dense: Most efficient row height for high bookmark counts.
config.densityDesc.auto: Adapts spacing to screen size and zoom.
config.helpPageConfigGeneralItems:
• Essentials / Advanced: Everyday options (language, appearance, layout, bookmarks) live under Essentials. Power features (smart collections, status, branding, search input, system tools) are under Advanced. Use the section links at the top of Advanced to jump. Click Show all sections on one page to view everything at once.
  • ℹ info buttons: Click the small ℹ next to a setting label for a short explanation in your current language.
  • Branding & PWA: Custom title and favicon (Advanced → Branding) apply to the browser tab, /manifest.webmanifest, and installed home-screen apps.
  • Tuning wizard (after onboarding): Once first-run onboarding finishes, a one-time 3-step guide may appear on the dashboard: language → theme → browser extension. Choices are saved immediately. Skip anytime.
  • Empty-library wizard: If you have no bookmarks yet, a follow-up guide opens config#pages and helps you add your first bookmark via quick-add or config#bookmarks.
  • Browser extension: Load the extension from the extension/ folder in your nextDash install, point it at your server URL, and save tabs as bookmarks. When the dashboard is open, saves can show a toast and refresh bookmarks automatically.
  • Re-run setup: Config → General → Advanced → Show onboarding wizard again (dashboard). To see the tuning wizard again, clear nextdash-post-tuning-wizard-v1 in browser localStorage.

colors.title: theme customization
colors.resetColorsMessage: Are you sure you want to reset all DEFAULT colors (dark/light) to default values? This action cannot be undone.
colors.customTabHint: Use Add Custom Theme to create a palette from the default starter colors.
colors.defaultDarkHint: Edits the default dark palette used when classic dark themes are active.
colors.defaultLightHint: Edits the default light palette used when classic light themes are active.
colors.palettesInfoMessage:
Three ways to edit colors on this tab:

• Dark and Light — change the fallback palettes for the classic dark/light themes in General → Appearance.

• Custom themes — create your own single-palette themes with Add Custom Theme. Each custom theme is one fixed look, not a day/night pair.

• Built-in named themes (Cherry Graphite, Nordic Frost, etc.) are picked in General → Appearance. Their packaged colors live in the server defaults unless you override palettes here.
colors.saveColorsInfoMessage:
Two separate save actions:

• Save colors (this tab) — writes palette edits from the Theme tab to the server. Use this after changing hex values or adding/removing custom themes.

• Save (config header) — stores General settings: which theme is active, layout, bookmarks, language, etc. It does not save color hex values from this tab.

Typical flow: edit colors → Save colors → pick the theme under General → Appearance → Save in the header.
colors.customThemesInfoMessage:
Custom themes are single palettes you create here.

• Add Custom Theme clones the default starter colors. Rename the theme and adjust colors in the editor on the right.

• To use it on the dashboard, select it under General → Appearance and click Save in the config header.

• Auto dark mode (General → Appearance) only works with built-in themes that have separate dark and light variants. It is disabled while a custom theme is selected — custom themes do not switch with your system appearance.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Quick setup in a few clicks. You can skip anytime.
onboarding.mobileWelcomeBody: Quick mobile setup — language and theme. Full settings are available on a computer or tablet.
onboarding.mobileLanguageThemeBody: Pick your language and dashboard theme.
onboarding.mobileFinishBody: Use search to open bookmarks. Swipe left or right to switch pages. Open config on a computer for full settings.
onboarding.languageStepBody: Pick your language and how links open.
onboarding.weatherLayoutStepBody: Choose weather display and tight columns behavior.
onboarding.tightColumnsHint: Tight columns fill vertical space better with many categories. Off keeps classic flow.
onboarding.searchTipsStepBody: Tune keyboard flow and footer hints.
onboarding.collectionsStepBody: nextDash can auto-group your bookmarks into dynamic sections. Enable the ones that suit your workflow — you can tweak them anytime in config.
onboarding.collectionsShowTodayHint: Shows bookmarks that match your time of day — work tools in the morning, leisure in the evening.
onboarding.collectionsShowMostUsedHint: Shows your most opened bookmarks at a glance.
onboarding.keyboardBookmarksStepBody: Use the arrow keys to move the highlight across the bookmark grid. Press Enter or Space to open. Press the semicolon key (;) to edit: works when a row is highlighted or when Tab has moved focus onto a bookmark link.
onboarding.mouseBookmarksStepBody: Use the narrow strip on the left as a drag handle to reorder bookmarks or drop them into another category. Press and hold on the bookmark row itself (not on that strip) for about half a second to open the inline editor.
onboarding.finishBodyReady: Setup complete. You can change anything later in config.
onboarding.finishBodyStart: Setup complete. Open config to add bookmarks or restore from a backup.

postSetup.pagesBody: Pages group bookmarks (Work, Personal, etc.). Open config → pages to rename tabs, reorder them, and choose how many you need.
postSetup.bookmarkBody: Press + for a quick one-line add, or & / Ctrl+Shift+A for the full bookmark form. You can also manage bookmarks in config.
postSetup.doneBody: Your dashboard is ready. You currently have {count} page(s) — add bookmarks anytime.

featureTour.step1Body: Discover the most powerful features in a few clicks. You can always skip the tour or restart it later via Config.
featureTour.step2Body: Press ":" or click this button. Change theme with :theme dark, adjust columns with :columns 4, or add a bookmark with :new. Commands are grouped and searchable.
featureTour.step3Body: Press "?" to open your finders. Finders are shortcuts to search engines. A DuckDuckGo finder is ready by default — type "?du linux" to search directly. Add or remove your own finders via Config → Finders.
featureTour.step4Body: Press ">" or click the search button. Use filters like status:online, category:work or tag:dev. Your search history and saved searches are always available.
featureTour.step5Body: Set the number of columns that fits your screen. Favicons are the website icons next to each bookmark — handy for quick recognition.
featureTour.step5ShowIconsHint: Website icons next to each bookmark for quick recognition.
featureTour.step6Body: nextDash automatically groups your bookmarks into dynamic sections. The Today collection shows bookmarks fitting your time of day: work tools in the morning, relaxation in the evening.
featureTour.step6TodayHint: Shows bookmarks that fit your time of day.
featureTour.step6MostUsedHint: Shows your most opened bookmarks in one overview.
featureTour.step7Body: Use arrow keys to navigate, Enter to open and ; to edit inline. Drag via the narrow handle strip on the left to reorder. In Config → Bookmarks you manage everything in bulk, import and export.
featureTour.step8Body: The tour is complete. All features are fully configurable via Config: themes, layout, finders, smart collections and bookmark management.

postTuning.languageBody: Pick the language for the dashboard and config. You can change this anytime under Config → General.
postTuning.themeBody: Choose a starting theme. Customize colors later under Config → theme.
postTuning.extensionBody: Install the nextDash browser extension to add the current tab as a bookmark without leaving the page.
